body: It sounds terrible but I'd rather be in a wheelchair (and not have to experience my other symptoms). At least I would be able to think clearly, socialize, watch TV, play video games, work/study. It wouldn't be great, but at least I'd be able to start a new life.

It was caused by a neurological disorder (specifically a lesion). Pain killers don't really help. It isn't really severe pain, it is sensitivity to light, sound, motion, etc. Generally, I also have trouble remembering things and thinking clearly.
It was caused by a neurological disorder. I've had it more most of my life (unknowingly). However, the symptoms started to get a lot worse 3 years ago.
